verdicts.reason: A keeps the centred headline, subline and CTA together as one group, but the italic subline is blown up to almost headline size, which flattens the hierarchy. It also sits cramped under the headline, and the CTA is undersized relative to the text. B shrinks the headline so the subline nearly matches it and leaves a huge dead gap in the middle. Its CTA is stranded in the bottom-left corner, close to the edge and off the centred axis, so it breaks grouping and alignment.
